facts.business: Power Finance Corporation Limited (PFC) is a Schedule-A Maharatna CPSE under the Ministry of Power and the largest government-owned NBFC in India, providing rupee term loans, short-term finance, lease financing, and transitional funding to the power sector and allied infrastructure including e-mobility, roads, ports, metro rail, and smart cities.
key_risks: Impairment of financial instruments - Loan Assets and Undisbursed letter of comfort
